newsitem.title: USA: Apple says VP Abrams still with company.
newsitem.headline: Apple says VP Abrams still with company.

text.p: Apple Computer Inc said Friday that Robin Abrams, a respected sales executive, is negotiating a new job at the company, after she gave up her role as acting executive vice president of worldwide sales.
"She is still with the company," said Jenni Johnston, an Apple corporate spokeswoman. "Her responsibilities are being negotiated."
The online version of trade magazine Computer Reseller News reported Friday that Abrams is expected to resign from the company.
Johnston said Abrams is still with Apple "as of today." She would not comment whether Abrams has notified the company that she plans to resign.
Abrams could not be immediately reached for comment.
Abrams, a liaison between the company and its dealers, temporarily assumed the top sales job at Apple two weeks ago when Marco Landi resigned.
Yesterday, the company rehired David Manovich, a former sales executive who left Apple in early 1996, to become executive vice president of sales and take over Abrams' duties.
